degradation_evidence.before: of10_* functions returned const u_char* pointer to current parse position
degradation_evidence.after: of10_* functions return void, errors propagated via nd_trunc() mechanism
degradation_evidence.impact: Any harness directly calling of10_* functions must be updated to handle new void return type

gap_introduced.description: OpenFlow parsing API refactored from pointer-return to void+nd_trunc() pattern
gap_introduced.harness_needs_update: Yes - harness calling of10_* functions directly must remove pointer return handling

rationale: API change modifies the contract between parser functions and their callers. Harnesses relying on pointer returns to track parse position will fail to compile or behave incorrectly.
